newsitem.title: UK: NWE low S straight-run fuel softer, high S firmer.
newsitem.headline: NWE low S straight-run fuel softer, high S firmer.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel prices were slightly softer with crude on Tuesday but high sulphur prices found support in tighter Russian supply.
Traders said that despite tighter January avails there was little buying interest left for low sulphur material.
North Sea cargoes were valued around $1 lower at $135 a tonne fob NWE but buyers and sellers stood apart.
High sulphur straight-run prices continued to find support in tighter Russian supplies in NWE and the Mediterranean.
E-4 cargoes were valued around $130 cif NWE, up 50 cents.
M40 in the Mediterranean was $1 firmer at $134-$136 a tonne cif.
